definitions.pass: guarded live invocation has a successful postcondition/read-back
definitions.partial: supported path passed, but a declared output or postcondition remains unverified
definitions.blocked: invocation cannot proceed because an explicit external/runtime prerequisite is absent
definitions.unsupported: the active runtime or backend explicitly rejects the capability
definitions.fail: invocation reached the implementation and exposed a code or contract defect
